The figure shows Sodium hydrogen carbonate。Sodium hydrogen carbonate, also known as baking soda, is a white solid compound with the formula NaHCO₃. It is a salt of carbonic acid and the sodium salt of bicarbonate. It is a component of most common household cleaning agents.
Sodium hydrogen carbonate is used in many industrial processes, including the manufacture of glass, paper, and textiles. It is also used as a food additive, in the treatment of gastric acid-related diseases, and as a cleaning agent.
